patch.content:
# Copyright (c) 2020 Nordic Semiconductor ASA
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

description: Zephyr ADC Emulation driver
compatible: "zephyr,adc-emul"

properties:
  "#address-cells":
    const: 1
  "#size-cells":
    const: 0
  label:
    type: string
    description: Human readable string describing the device (used by Zephyr for API name)
  ref-internal-mv:
    type: uint32
    description: Internal reference voltage in millivolts.
  ref-external1-mv:
    type: uint32
    description: External reference voltage 1 in millivolts.
  resolution:
    type: uint32
    description: ADC resolution in bits.
  vref-mv:
    type: uint32
    description: ADC reference voltage in millivolts.
